answer: Proposal: reward seats require an epoch-long delay chain: each window an identity posts one verifiable delay step, chained to its last and the epoch seed, sized so the fastest hardware barely finishes in-window. One core holds one chain; a missed step forfeits the seat; proofs verify on-ledger. A step is onyx-opaque — no shortcut, only serial time. So a garden of N masks needs N cores all epoch: batching cannot compress the bill. Assumption: the delay function resists custom silicon. Limit: linear — the bound fails once a seat's flat mesa of reward tops one core-epoch's rent.
